text: 金十数据10月25日讯，澳洲联储助理主席亨特表示，该行抗击通胀的进程“尚未结束”。这释放出一个信号：在下月初的政策会议上，澳洲联储很可能会再次加息。在周日的节目采访中，亨特谈及了高利率对消费者及房价的影响。她表示：“为了持续应对这一挑战，理事会今年已经实施了四次加息。”当被问及澳洲联储是否已采取足够措施来抑制通胀时，她回答道：“很遗憾，还没有。”本周早些时候，市场对11月3日会议上再次加息的预期已有所升温。此前，澳洲联储副主席豪泽在周三表示，当前的通胀前景较该行8月份的评估结果“明显恶化”。9月下旬，澳洲联储将利率上调至4.6%，创下15年来的最高水平。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 25: RBA Assistant Governor Hunter said the bank's fight against inflation is "not over." This sends a signal that the RBA is likely to raise rates again at next month's policy meeting. In a Sunday program interview, Hunter discussed the impact of high interest rates on consumers and housing prices. She said: "To continue addressing this challenge, the Board has implemented four rate hikes this year." When asked whether the RBA has done enough to curb inflation, she replied: "Unfortunately, not yet." Earlier this week, market expectations for another rate hike at the November 3 meeting had already increased. Previously, RBA Deputy Governor Hauser said on Wednesday that the current inflation outlook has "deteriorated markedly" compared with the bank's August assessment. In late September, the RBA raised rates to 4.6%, a 15-year high.
